scope: Conservative electrical screens, not a validated operating envelope or physical test

qualification_remaining: Manufacturer resistor derating/pulse curve and local hotspot temperature
TMC reference/resistance temperature dependence and regulation overshoot
Kelvin sense/ground layout and physical current measurement

adc.measures: VBUS_PROTECTED upstream of eFuse; does not measure regenerative VM

efuse.high_current_control_requirement: Valid PD contract >=1.5 A before PB14 high; 5 V bootstrap motor disabled

regeneration_example.load_envelope_status: blocked pending application load, speed, inertia, deceleration and backdrive limits
regeneration_example.formula: VM_final=sqrt(VM_initial^2 + 2*returned_energy/C_min); transient ESR and switching overshoot must also be qualified
